claim_text: USAO-MN alleges that Smart Therapy obtained more than $14 million in EIDBI reimbursement funds from Minnesota DHS and UCare between approximately November 2019 and December 2024. This amount remains a charging-era allegation and must not be treated as restitution, forfeiture, recovery, or a program-wide loss total.

amounts.methodology: USAO-MN release says Smart Therapy obtained more than $14 million in EIDBI reimbursement funds; the amount is tied to charged conduct and is not an adjudicated loss.

qualifiers: CHARGED_ALLEGED dollar figure even though Hassan later pleaded guilty; the plea agreement is not captured here to allocate an admitted loss amount.
Separate from the approximately $465,000 Federal Child Nutrition Program allegation.
Overlaps later Smart Therapy / Star Autism program figures and must not be added to them.
